```{r, echo=FALSE,warning=FALSE}
library(ggplot2)
library(BsMD)
library(tidyverse)
```


```{r}
data <- read.csv("TypingData.csv", header = TRUE)

data <- data %>%
  mutate(
    Block = factor(Block),
    A = factor(A, levels = c(-1, 1), labels = c("Mechanical", "Apple")),      # Keyboard type
    B = factor(B, levels = c(-1, 1), labels = c("Silent", "Music")),         # Background music
    C = factor(C, levels = c(-1, 1), labels = c("Random", "Paragraph"))     # Text type
  )
```

```{r}
# --- Step 1: full model, testing block interactions ---------------------
model_full <- aov(y ~ Block * A * B * C, data = data)
summary(model_full)
```

```{r}
# --- Step 2: if block interactions are non-significant, pool into error --
model_reduced <- aov(y ~ Block + A * B * C, data = data)
summary(model_reduced)
```

```{r}
# --- Step 3: formally test whether pooling is justified ------------------
anova(model_reduced, model_full)
```
```{r, fig.width=8, fig.height=5}
boxplot(y ~ Block, data = data, xlab = "Participant", ylab = "WPM",
        col = c("skyblue", "yellow","salmon"), main = "WPM by Block")
```

```{r, fig.width=15, fig.height=5}
par(mfrow = c(1, 3))

boxplot(y ~ A, data = data, xlab = "Keyboard (A)", ylab = "WPM",
        col = c("skyblue", "salmon"), main = "WPM by Keyboard Type")

boxplot(y ~ B, data = data, xlab = "Music (B)", ylab = "WPM",
        col = c("lightgreen", "orange"), main = "WPM by Background Music")

boxplot(y ~ C, data = data, xlab = "Text Type (C)", ylab = "WPM",
        col = c("plum", "gold"), main = "WPM by Text Type")

par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
```

```{r}
# check model assumptions
par(mfrow = c(1, 3))

hist(model_reduced$residuals, xlab = "Residuals",
     main = "Histogram of Residuals", probability = TRUE)

qqnorm(model_reduced$residuals)
qqline(model_reduced$residuals)

plot(x = model_reduced$fitted.values, y = model_reduced$residuals,
     xlab = "Fitted Values", ylab = "Residuals",
     main = "Residuals vs. Fitted Values")
abline(h = 0)
```

```{r , fig.width=20, fig.height=5}
# --- Step 5: visualize effects ---------------------------------------------
par(mfrow = c(1, 3))

interaction.plot(data$A, data$B, data$y, trace.label = "Music",
                  xlab = "Keyboard", ylab = "WPM (y)",
                  main = "Keyboard x Music", ylim = c(48,58))

interaction.plot(data$A, data$C, data$y, trace.label = "Text Type",
                  xlab = "Keyboard", ylab = "WPM (y)",
                  main = "Keyboard x Text", ylim = c(48,58))

interaction.plot(data$B, data$C, data$y, trace.label = "Text Type",
                  xlab = "Music", ylab = "WPM (y)",
                  main = "Music x Text", ylim = c(48,58))

par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
```


```{r, fig.width=20, fig.height=5}

# faceted by block, to eyeball whether patterns are consistent across blocks
data %>%
  group_by(Block, A, B) %>%
  summarize(mean_y = mean(y), .groups = "drop") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = A, y = mean_y, color = B, group = B)) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  geom_line() +
  facet_wrap(~Block) +
  labs(y = "mean WPM", title = "A x B interaction by Block")
```

```{r, fig.width=20, fig.height=5}
# --- 7. A x C interaction, faceted by Block ---------------------------------
data %>%
  group_by(Block, A, C) %>%
  summarize(mean_y = mean(y), .groups = "drop") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = A, y = mean_y, color = C, group = C)) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  geom_line() +
  facet_wrap(~Block) +
  labs(y = "mean WPM", title = "A x C interaction by Block")
```


```{r, fig.width=20, fig.height=5}
# --- 8. B x C interaction, faceted by Block ---------------------------------
data %>%
  group_by(Block, B, C) %>%
  summarize(mean_y = mean(y), .groups = "drop") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = B, y = mean_y, color = C, group = C)) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  geom_line() +
  facet_wrap(~Block) +
  labs(y = "mean WPM", title = "B x C interaction by Block")
```
```{r, fig.width=12, fig.height=5}
# --- Create a run order variable within each block --------------------------
data <- data %>%
  group_by(Block) %>%
  mutate(RunOrder = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup()

# --- Run chart: WPM over run order, one line per block ----------------------
ggplot(data, aes(x = RunOrder, y = y)) +
  geom_line(color = "steelblue") +
  geom_point(size = 2, color = "steelblue") +
  facet_wrap(~Block) +
  labs(x = "Run Order", y = "WPM",
       title = "WPM by Run Order, Faceted by Block") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r, fig.width=12, fig.height=5}
ggplot(data, aes(x = RunOrder, y = y, color = A, group = A)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  facet_wrap(~Block) +
  labs(x = "Run Order", y = "WPM", color = "Keyboard",
       title = "WPM by Run Order, Faceted by Block, Colored by Keyboard (A)") +
  theme_minimal()
```
